latin_incipit: Tres modi demonstrationis sunt utiles in se ipsis: primus, secundus et quartus.
english_translation: Three modes of demonstration are useful in themselves: the first, second, and fourth.
charge: [Classification of logical demonstrations: no heretical charge]
exegesis: These remarks pertain to Aristotelian logic—types of demonstration (direct, reductio, hypothetical), and the limits of logical proof. Pico is exploring the epistemological structure of knowledge and the risk of hidden circularity.

scholar_citations.work: Posterior Analytics II.14-26 (on types of demonstration)
scholar_citations.quote: There are four modes of demonstration: direct proof, proof by division, indirect proof (reductio), and hypothetical proof.
Demonstration by negation and proof by contradiction are more certain than affirmative demonstration in some cases.
Pico's emphasis on logical precision reflects his effort to systematize diverse philosophical traditions into a coherent framework.

notes: Technical logical position; important for Pico's understanding of demonstration and proof structure in metaphysics and theology.
